segmentName: Animal & Human APIs and Specialty Chemicals (dual-market)

market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Global veterinary API market: $7.93B (2024) to $11.79B by 2029 (8.2%/yr), or $9.8B (2025) to $19.6B by 2035 (7.2%/yr). Global specialty chemicals: ~$979B (2024) to $1,313B by 2030 (~5-6.3%/yr); pharmaceutical chemicals sub-segment specifically: $159.22B (2026) to $265.87B by 2033 (7.6%/yr).
market.domesticSlice: India veterinary API manufacturing: $547.7M (2024) to $1,133.3M by 2033 (8.4%/yr), ~5.9% of global market (2024). India veterinary pharmaceuticals (broader, incl. formulations): $1.16-1.73B (2024) to $2.22-4.17B by 2033, 7.5-10.23%/yr depending on source.

structureFacts: India's National Animal Disease Control Programme (NADCP) targets vaccinating 530M cattle against FMD; 200M+ vaccinated as of 2024 — a structural driver of veterinary pharma demand
CDSCO mandated (Sept 2024) all new veterinary drug approvals go via the SUGAM Portal — expected to speed approvals and increase transparency
~80% of veterinary drugs sold in India must meet updated GMP standards
Rashtriya Gokul Mission and National Livestock Mission are improving breed quality/productivity and expanding rural veterinary access

adoptionStructure.note: Not a repurchase-rate category; demand is regulated-market qualification and institutional-buyer relationship driven, similar to human API supply

peers.name: Sequent Scientific Ltd (now Viyash Scientific, post-2024 merger)
peers.note: ROE deeply negative (-19.0% FY23 to -5.1% FY24), net margin fell from 8.6% to 2.2% — a cautionary comparable showing this segment's margin can be volatile even at scale; merged Nov 2024 into an integrated global animal-health player with 16 facilities, 150+ market access

drivers: established supplier relationships and quality/compliance track record (GMP, US FDA site compliance)
negotiated long-term pricing for regulated-market customers
reliable, compliant, diversified supply reduces single-source risk for global animal-health and pharma formulators

steps: offer a broad multi-category API portfolio (veterinary + human + specialty chemicals)
position as a single-source supplier across categories
run greenfield/brownfield capacity expansions for new pipeline products
maintain consistent quality/documentation across dual (animal+human) regulatory regimes
recurring purchase orders across both animal-health and human-pharma customer bases
